card.name: Quantifiers inside example lists
card.fires_on: The comma or quantifier (most, some, various) that comes right after 'such as', 'including' or 'e.g.' or partway through a list of examples, just before the next group of items is named.

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma after an item in a list of example drugs, right before the next drug name.
modes.example: dolutegravir, enfuvirtide, nevirapine, all NRTIs<<,>> raltegravir, and tipran

modes.label: Quantifier after including
modes.description: Words like most, some or various placed after 'including', 'such as' or 'e.g.' and before a category noun.
modes.example: nonbacterial infections such as<< most>> upper respiratory tract infections

card.plain: It marks the spot in an example list where a vague amount word like most or some leads into a group of items.
